note: SPECIAL-DISTRICT TERRITORY, RESOLVED BY DOCUMENT RATHER THAN BY GEOMETRY. Created 2026-08-21 (NH Hunt 2, item 4, HUNT05). TIGER publishes no boundary for any special district at any vintage, so the national boundary join resolves none of the country's 39,555 of them and the gap ledger correctly reports every one as UNRESOLVED. This file is where a district resolved by a DOCUMENT is recorded, so that a resolution reached by a hunt reaches the ledger instead of living in an evidence page nothing reads. Every entry names its evidence and the date it was read. A district absent from this file stays UNRESOLVED, which is the honest default: 'we could not find its boundary' is never 'it does not govern here'.

districts.name: MERRIMACK COUNTY CONSERVATION DISTRICT
districts.evidence: RSA 432:12, read 2026-08-21 at rung 2 on gencourt.state.nh.us: 'each of the 10 counties within the state is hereby incorporated into a conservation district; each of the 10 districts shall be known by the name of the county to which its boundaries conform.' 03255's ZCTA samples 109 points and all 109 fall in Merrimack County. The district's own site, merrimackccd.org, says the same in its own words.

districts.name: LAKE TODD VILLAGE DISTRICT
districts.evidence: Its own history page, read 2026-08-21 from the Internet Archive's 2014-01-08 capture because the live site is 404 at rungs 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6: 'Lake Todd Village District was formed in 2004 by the litoral owners of Lake Todd, located in Bradford and Newbury, New Hampshire, in accordance with ... RSA 52.' The same page: the warrant and budget are posted 'in the Bradford Post Office and outside the Newbury Town Office.' Independently, the NH Department of Revenue Administration's 2025 Village District Tax Rates lists 'Lake Todd Village*' twice at $0.29, under two municipalities — the asterisk-and-repeat pattern that file uses for a district spanning more than one.

districts.name: ANDOVER FIRE DISTRICT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Andover Fire Dist #1  $0.44' under Andover, and under no other municipality. 03255 is entirely within Newbury town.

districts.name: ANDOVER VILLAGE DISTRICT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Andover Village  $0.00' under Andover. The file lists a district even at a zero rate, which is what makes its absence from Newbury's block meaningful.

districts.name: EAST ANDOVER FIRE PRECINCT
districts.evidence: Listed under Andover, and under no other municipality.

districts.name: B C E P SOLID WASTE DISTRICT
districts.basis: ENABLING STATUTE AND ITS OWN NAME
districts.evidence: Not a village district and not in the DRA table. A solid-waste district under RSA 53-B, formed by Barnstead, Chichester, Epsom and Pittsfield — the four towns its initials name. Newbury is not among them.

districts.name: CENTRAL HOOKSETT WATER PRECINCT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Central Hooksett Water  $0.00' under Hooksett.

districts.name: HOOKSETT VILLAGE WATER PRECINCT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Hooksett Village Water  $0.00' under Hooksett.

districts.name: CONCORD HOUSING AUTHORITY
districts.evidence: A municipal housing authority under RSA 203, created by and for the City of Concord. Not a village district and not in the DRA table.

districts.name: CONTOOCOOK VILLAGE PRECINCT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Contoocook Village  $1.34' under Hopkinton. Contoocook is a village of Hopkinton; the Census unit file's own web_address for it is a page on hopkintonnh.gov.

districts.name: HARDY ROAD VILLAGE DISTRICT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Hardy Road Village  $1.92' under Loudon.

districts.name: NEW LONDON SPRINGFIELD WATER SYSTEM PRECINCT
districts.basis: DRA VILLAGE DISTRICT TAX RATES, AND ITS OWN NAME
districts.evidence: Listed as 'New London-Springfield*' twice — $1.49 and $1.04 — under New London and under Springfield, and under no third municipality. Its own site (nlswp.com, read 2026-08-21 at rung 2, HTTP 200) titles it 'New London-Springfield Water System Precinct'. Newbury abuts New London and is not in it.

districts.name: PENACOOK BOSCAWEN WATER PRECINCT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Penacook-Boscawen Water  $0.00' under Boscawen. Penacook is a village of Concord.

districts.name: WARNER VILLAGE WATER DISTRICT
districts.evidence: Listed as 'Warner Village Water  $1.60' under Warner, unasterisked and once. Warner also lists it on its own Boards page as an elected body.

residualUncertainty: Sixteen of the eighteen are settled by a district's ABSENCE from Newbury's block in one annual document. A district that both levies nothing and is omitted from the table entirely would be invisible to this method. Two things reduce that and neither eliminates it: the table lists zero-rate districts rather than skipping them, and both multi-town cases in scope were caught by it. This sentence is here so the next session inherits the limit along with the answer.
